$comment: A read-only profile: infra-copilot:status and nothing else. Use it to audit a
production infra repo without granting any way to change it.
status promises to change nothing and goes to some length to keep that promise —
it reads run status through the HCP API rather than running terraform plan, and
uses git --no-optional-locks so it does not touch git's index. This profile turns
